messages.content: Before we choose Mission Bay, I need the discrepancy cleared up. The room page says two queens for four, but the last screen looks like it only accepts two guests. Can Daniel, Owen, and I all be named on it? Also confirm the $4,150.92 includes the resort fee and give me the cancellation cutoff in Chicago time.
I’ll verify the occupancy against the actual rate terms, then reconcile every mandatory charge and convert the deadline from San Diego time.
Good. If all three of us cannot be on the reservation, remove it and we’ll use Coronado.

Mission Bay is cleared. The Bay View Two Queens with Balcony permits four occupants, and Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee can all be listed on the reservation. The complete seven-night total is $4,150.92, including the room, mandatory nightly resort fee, estimated taxes and assessments, and self-parking. Free cancellation ends June 15 at 11:59 p.m. in San Diego, which is June 16 at 1:59 a.m. in Chicago. Nothing has been booked; Mission Bay remains the lead option.

Mission Bay still leads; Marcus and Daniel have not yet selected flights or lodging.
